issue.title: Rows with an inch mark in the description fail to import
issue.body:
Our purchasing card export has the columns Date, Description, Amount, Category,
and nothing in it is quoted. Any row whose description has an inch mark, like

    2026-10-14,Monitor 27" Dell U2724D,-349.00,IT equipment

fails with 'Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header' at
that row; the quote seems to swallow the rest of the line. I've opened PR #952,
which treats a quote in the middle of a field as an ordinary character. Please
merge it right away: our month end is on Friday and we have forty of these.

input.title: Treat a quote mid-field as an ordinary character in splitFields
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In splitFields, a double quote opens quoted mode wherever it appears, including in the middle of an unquoted field such as Monitor 27" Dell U2724D. That swallows the rest of the line and the row fails assertShape. Change it so a quote opens a quoted field only when it is the first character of a field; elsewhere in an unquoted field it is kept as a literal character. Quoted fields with commas and "" escapes must keep working.
